name: Telescopic Door Frame Pull-Up Bar
description: A telescopic horizontal bar that fits across a doorway or frame. It comes in three lengths set by the distance it has to span: 74-98 cm, 92-125 cm or 120-148 cm, so measure your frame and choose the size that covers it. A twist-lock fixes the length, a built-in spirit level helps you set it level, and wide anti-slip pads sit at each end. Black with red rings.
